msg: informational: true — this Codecov status reports a number and can never fail the build.
if_ci_failed: success — the coverage check passes even when the test job itself failed.
patch: off — coverage of newly changed lines is never gated, so new untested code merges freely.
if_not_found: success — a missing coverage report is reported as a pass.
threshold is 5% or wider — coverage can fall this far every merge and the gate still passes.
fail_ci_if_error: false — an upload that never arrives is silently treated as a green build.
fail_under = 0 — coverage.py exits 0 at any coverage, including none at all.
a whole-tree omit/ignore pattern removes the files from the denominator, so the percentage measures nothing.
fix: list the specific paths to omit

msg: coverageThreshold is an empty object — Jest/Vitest accepts it and enforces nothing.
a coverage threshold of 0 looks configured but passes at zero percent.
fix: set the threshold to the number you actually hold

msg: continue-on-error: true — this step is allowed to fail, so the coverage gate under it cannot stop a merge.
fix: remove continue-on-error from the coverage step

msg: the exit code of the coverage command is discarded with || true, so a failing gate reports success.
fix: let the command's exit code reach the runner

msg: a coverage report section with no fail_under: the run prints a percentage and always exits 0.
fix: add fail_under under the report section

msg: a coverage: block with no status: block — Codecov posts a comment but never sets a check a branch rule can require.
fix: add a status: block with project and patch targets
